verdict.rationale: Codex's docs appear to be served as raw markdown pages (the cited URLs such as learn.chatgpt.com/docs/codex/cli.md and /docs/extend/mcp.md end in .md), which gives an agent a readable doc surface. However, probes found no llms.txt at platform.openai.com and no markdown version of the platform Codex page (both 404). Missing for 10: a working llms.txt index, a documented agent-oriented docs entry point, consistent markdown availability across doc hosts, and independent confirmation that agents can consume the docs.
